minutes.headline: Planning Board heard a nine-lot Elmwood Road subdivision, approved a Sunset Lane ANR 3-1, and sent a Page Street ANR to legal.
minutes.summary: The board held and closed a public hearing on a nine-lot subdivision at 50 Elmwood Road. The peer reviewer raised the dead-end length waiver, street trees and the zoning line, and the board wants conservation, sewer and building official input. Three ANR plans were reviewed. The Sunset Lane plan was approved with one abstention, and the Page Street plan was held for legal advice on its agricultural restriction. The board also discussed a medical marijuana bylaw for May and its process for bringing bylaws to Town Meeting.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board held and closed a public hearing on a nine-lot subdivision at 50 Elmwood Road, and will deliberate at a later meeting.
The board approved the ANR plan for Sunset Lane, 3-1 with one abstention.
The Page Street ANR was held while staff research legal questions on its agricultural preservation restriction.
Staff will seek written input on the Elmwood Road zoning line and lot sizes from the building official, and sewer feedback from the Sewer Commission.
Medical marijuana bylaw drafts will be read and discussed at the next meeting, with public safety officials invited.

why_it_matters: A nine-lot subdivision on Elmwood Road affects neighbors through septic versus sewer, street design and zoning, and the board has not yet decided on it.
A medical marijuana bylaw aimed at May is something residents would be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
